01 — APPLIED AI / FULL-STACK · 2025–2026

EnergyAI

From smart-meter readings to informed energy decisions. A complete platform for monitoring consumption, understanding costs, and forecasting demand with visible uncertainty.

Next.jsFastAPIPostgreSQLPyTorchAzure
Request a walkthrough ↗
Inside the project

The challenge. A forecast only helps when people can understand its inputs, uncertainty, and limitations.

  • Built the application, REST APIs, authentication, role-based access, migrations, data ingestion, alerts, and exports.
  • Integrated Global Temporal Fusion Transformers for 24-hour and 168-hour predictions, plus Chronos-2 for 30 daily forecasts.
  • Made data coverage, model provenance, readiness checks, and labelled fallbacks part of the user experience.
  • Used chronological evaluation, leakage audits, baseline comparisons, automated tests, and deployment health checks.

Delivery. Containerized and deployed on Azure for academic demonstration and jury review. Completed as my master’s final project; this is not a claim of commercial-scale validation. Source repository is private.

02 — COMPUTER VISION

ASL alphabet recognition

Connecting hand gestures to language through a webcam application, with two distinct machine-learning approaches and interactive practice.

TensorFlowMediaPipeOpenCVFlask
Explore source ↗
How it works

MediaPipe extracts hand landmarks from webcam frames. A MobileNet model classifies skeleton images; an alternative Random Forest uses 75 engineered landmark features. The application returns predictions across 26 alphabet classes with confidence scores.

The project explores both deep learning and feature engineering. It is an alphabet-recognition prototype, rather than a full sign-language translator.
